title: Fix WebSocketBridge reconnect retry loop (F7/F16)
description:
## Finding F7/F16 (Council: P1, 90% confidence / Skeptical: 75% confidence)

WebSocketBridge.RunReceiveLoopWithRetryAsync is documented to retry up to maxRetries=3 with 5-second delay, but silently aborts after the first failed reconnect attempt.

## Root Cause
When the first reconnect fails, _ws.State != Open. On the next loop iteration, ReceiveLoopAsync's while condition checks _ws.State == Open which is false, so it returns immediately without throwing. The retry loop treats this as "clean shutdown" and exits via `return`. The "All retries exhausted" LogError is never reached.

## Effect
Agent goes permanently deaf silently. Only a LogWarning for the first failed reconnect is emitted. Attempts 2 and 3 never run.

## Recommendation
Distinguish "receive loop returned because socket was never opened" from "receive loop returned because connection closed cleanly." After a failed reconnect (_ws.State != Open), skip re-entering ReceiveLoopAsync — either `continue` explicitly or track a `reconnectSucceeded` bool. Add a test that fails the first reconnect attempt and asserts the loop tries a second and third time.
